snippet.title: JDM: Japanese Drift Master | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Buy JDM now at - https://cutt.ly/JDM-Steam 

JDM: Japanese Drift Master is a simcade racing game, taking players to a fictional Japanese prefecture - Guntama. Explore 250km of open world roads; Experience a full single player story campaign; one of the most robust tuning systems in a modern racing game; two different driving models (simcade and arcade); drift, grip and drag event races; and fully licensed, legendary cars coming from the biggest Japanese manufacturers.

#LetsDrift #gaming #racingsim

–

Steam https://cutt.ly/JDM-Steam
GoG https://cutt.ly/JDM-GOG
Epic https://cutt.ly/JDM-Epic
